'''Zorin Krasul''' was a [[Cathar/Legends|Cathar]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Senator/Legends|senator]] who represented the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Anaxes/Legends|Anaxes]] in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].

==Biography==
In [[3643 BBY]], the [[Meteor (Havoc Squad)|new commander]] of Havoc Squad was called to a Senate hearing to discuss the defection of the previous one, at which Krasul was one of the overseers. Afterwards, Krasul was captured by [[Zora|Wraith]], a former soldier from [[Havoc Squad]] who joined the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]]. He was taken to [[Port Raga]] and was forced to confess to the Senate about abandoning Havoc Squad on [[Ando Prime/Legends|Ando Prime]]. When the new Havoc Squad arrived to rescue him, Wraith escaped, leaving the Senator on a bomb chair that would go off if he attempted to move. Havoc Squad was able to defuse the bomb and Krasul escorted back to Coruscant under the watch of Sergeant [[Ava Jaxo]]. Krasul's [[Ondia Krasul|wife]] later sent a message to Havoc Squad, telling them that they had earned an ally in the Senate.

Sometime after the outbreak of the [[Galactic War]], Havoc Squad was called for another Senate hearing to discuss their activities. The Senator behind the hearing, [[Grom Zian]], labeled the squad a threat to the Republic, claiming that they abuse their position. In turn, the Havoc CO present evidence gathered by the [[Republic Strategic Information Service|SIS]] revealing Zian to be a paid agent for the Empire. Though Zian tried to deny the evidence, claiming these to be "wild accusations" and "paranoid delusions". Krasul stood up for the CO, stating that his rescuer deserved more than to be dismissed out of hand. The Senate committee then reviewed the evidence before ordering the [[Senate Guard/Legends|Senate Guard]] to detain Zian for [[Treason/Legends|high treason]].

==Behind the scenes==
According to the game's conversation files, Krasul's kidnapping was originally planned to occur after the Nar Shaddaa storyline, and would have taken place in the Red Light Sector of Nar Shaddaa rather than Port Raga.
